valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E (FY2027 adjusted diluted EPS viewed at the 12-month target date)

bear.driver: P&C rate softening slows organic growth to ~3% and AssuredPartners integration weighs on margins

base.driver: 5% combined organic growth, steady tuck-in M&A, and continued EBITDAC margin expansion

bull.driver: 6-7% organic growth, faster AssuredPartners synergies, and multiple expansion toward peer highs

valuation.implied_by_close: At base FY2027E EPS of $14.80, the $282.94 close implies 19.1x; the ~$301-$304 Street consensus target implies ~20.4x or $14.73 EPS at 20.5x.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $14.80 (5.2 pp of price return at the $282.94 close).
valuation.watch_metric: Combined Brokerage & Risk Management organic revenue growth and adjusted EBITDAC margin

analyst_notes: Following Q3 2026 earnings on October 29, 2026 (adjusted EPS $3.00, 5% organic growth, $1.25B adjusted EBITDAC), named analysts including Yaron Kinar (Mizuho, $307), Andrew Andersen (Jefferies, $319), Rowland Mayor (RBC, $315), Mark Hughes (Truist, $275), and Meyer Shields (KBW, $275) raised targets into the $275-$319 range before the November 13 cutoff. The average of these post-earnings targets (~$298.20) sits slightly below our $303.40 base case (-1.8 pp gap, or ~$0.25 of EPS at 20.5x), reflecting caution on sequential EBITDAC margin trends from Truist and KBW. Additional updates from Morgan Stanley ($325), Argus ($317), and Wells Fargo ($294) occurred after the November 13 reference close and are excluded.
